overview.historicalContext: Kuratowski's theorem (1930) characterizes planar graphs: G is planar iff it contains no subdivision of K₅ or K₃,₃. This replaces the topological definition (embedding in R²) with a purely combinatorial criterion.
overview.problemStatement: Define isPlanar for SimpleGraph using Kuratowski's characterization, replacing the sorry in Erdos1019Problem.lean.
overview.text: Kuratowski planarity definition using subdivisions of K₅ and K₃,₃
overview.proofStrategy: Define Subdivision structure (branch vertices + connecting paths), then isPlanarKuratowski as absence of K₅ and K₃,₃ subdivisions.
keyInsights: The Subdivision structure captures the topological minor relation without requiring topological spaces.
